name: WPBulkify
author: WPBulkify

sections.description:
🚀 Transform WordPress Site Setup From Hours to Minutes!

WPBulkify is the essential backend plugin that powers the WPBulkify browser extension (Chrome & Firefox) — enabling bulk plugin and theme management, smart conflict detection, and seamless site configuration across browsers.

What WPBulkify Does for You: ✨

  • 🔧 Bulk Plugin & Theme Installation – Install multiple plugins and themes in seconds instead of hours
  • 📋 Site Profiles – Save reusable WordPress configurations (plugins + themes + checklists) for instant site setup
  • ⚠️ Conflict Detection – Automatically detect and prevent incompatible plugins before installation
  • 📊 Update Monitoring – See which installed plugins need updates at a glance (Pro)
  • ☁️ Cloud Sync – Save profiles in the cloud and restore them across any browser or device (Pro)
  • 🌟 WordPress.org Integration – View plugin ratings, installation counts, compatibility, and reviews directly
  • ⚡ Lightning Fast – Optimized REST API endpoints for batch processing
  • 🛡️ Secure & Reliable – Uses WordPress core functions, CSP headers, CSRF protection
  • 🔄 REST API Ready – Modern REST endpoints + AJAX fallback for compatibility

Perfect For: 🎯

  • 🏢 WordPress Agencies – Set up client sites in minutes instead of days
  • 👨‍💻 Developers – Streamline local development and staging environment setup
  • 🎨 Freelancers – Quickly deploy consistent plugin stacks across multiple client sites
  • 🤝 Support Teams – Install the same plugin configuration across dozens of sites daily
  • 🔧 Site Builders – Create reusable profiles and deploy them with one click

Key Features Included: 🎁

✅ Bulk Installation – Install multiple plugins/themes in one go
✅ Theme Management – Full theme installation, activation, and deletion
✅ Smart Profiles – Save plugins + themes + task checklists for different site types
✅ Conflict Detection – 12 incompatible plugin pairs + 8 category conflicts detected automatically
✅ Update Checker – Know which plugins need updates instantly (Pro only)
✅ Cloud Backup – Sync profiles across browsers and devices (Pro only)
✅ No Helper Needed – Works with WordPress 5.5+ without a separate helper plugin
✅ Cross-Browser – Available for both Chrome and Firefox
✅ Backward Compatible – All data preserved during updates

How It Works: 🔄

  1. Install this plugin on your WordPress site
  2. Download the WPBulkify browser extension:
    • Chrome Web Store
    • Firefox Add-ons
  3. Create profiles with your favorite plugins/themes/checklists
  4. Deploy to your site in seconds with one click
  5. Watch as everything installs and activates automatically

Trusted By:
✓ 10,000+ WordPress professionals
✓ 1,000+ agencies managing multiple client sites
✓ Developers saving thousands of hours on site setup

What Users Are Saying:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “This changed how we onboard clients. We went from 30 minutes per site to 2 minutes!” — Agency Owner
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “Finally, a sane way to bulk install themes and plugins without clicking 100 times.” — Developer

sections.installation:
Quick Setup (2 minutes):

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/wpbulkify/ directory, or install via Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Download the WPBulkify browser extension (Chrome or Firefox)
  4. Visit your WordPress admin page in the browser
  5. Use the extension to start installing plugins and themes in bulk!

System Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.4 or higher
– Administrator access to install plugins
– Chrome or Firefox browser
sections.faq:
What is WPBulkify?

WPBulkify is a WordPress plugin paired with a browser extension that enables bulk installation of plugins and themes, along with smart conflict detection and cloud syncing of configurations. This plugin provides the WordPress backend; the extension handles the user interface.

Do I need the browser extension?

Yes, you’ll need the WPBulkify browser extension installed. It’s available for:
– Chrome: Chrome Web Store
– Firefox: Firefox Add-ons

The plugin alone won’t do anything — it’s the backend companion to the extension.

How is this different from other bulk plugin installers?

WPBulkify offers:
– Reusable profiles you can save and deploy across multiple sites
– Smart conflict detection that prevents installation of incompatible plugins
– Cloud sync to restore profiles on any device
– Theme support — not just plugins
– Update monitoring to stay on top of outdated plugins
– Zero learning curve — works directly in your browser

Is this safe?

Yes. The plugin uses only WordPress core functions for installation and activation. It follows WordPress security best practices including CSP headers, nonce validation, and CSRF protection. No files are modified or executed outside normal WordPress operations.

What WordPress version do I need?

WordPress 5.0 or higher with PHP 7.4+. Tested up to WordPress 6.9. Works best on WordPress 5.5+ (no helper plugin needed on newer versions).

Can I install plugins from sources other than WordPress.org?

Currently, WPBulkify works with plugins from the official WordPress.org repository. Custom plugin uploads are planned for future releases.

What if a plugin installation fails?

The plugin includes comprehensive error handling. If one plugin fails to install, the others continue. You’ll see which plugins succeeded and which failed, with reasons for any failures.

Do I need administrator access?

Yes, installing plugins requires administrator-level permissions, just like doing it manually through WordPress.

Can I use this on multisite?

The plugin is optimized for single-site WordPress installations. Multisite support is being evaluated for future releases.

Does this work on mobile?

WPBulkify works on desktop browsers:
– Chrome on Windows, macOS, Linux
– Firefox on Windows, macOS, Linux

Mobile browser support (iOS Safari, Android Firefox) is not currently available.

What’s included in the Pro version?

Pro users get:
– ☁️ Cloud sync across browsers and devices
– 📊 Plugin update monitoring
– Unlimited profiles (free: 3 profiles)
– Unlimited plugins (free: 10 plugins)
– Priority support

How much does Pro cost?

$49/year for individual users. See WPBulkify pricing for details.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Install the browser extension, click Settings, and activate your license. Your data syncs automatically once activated.

What data is synced to the cloud?

Only your plugin and theme profiles are synced (the lists you save). This data is encrypted and stored securely on our servers. WordPress site data is never touched or uploaded.

Can I bulk-update plugins?

Not yet, but update monitoring (Pro) shows you which plugins are outdated. One-click bulk updates are planned for future releases.

Where can I get help?

Visit wpbulkify.com/support or check the browser extension settings for help links.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • ✨ Theme installation and management support
  • ✨ Site Profiles — save plugins, themes, and task checklists
  • ✨ Cloud Sync (Pro) — sync profiles across browsers and devices
  • ✨ Plugin Conflict Detection — prevent incompatible plugin combinations
  • ✨ Update Monitoring (Pro) — see which plugins need updates
  • ✨ WordPress.org Integration — plugin ratings, installs, compatibility inline
  • 🔧 Direct REST API support (WordPress 5.5+, helper plugin optional)
  • 🔧 Retry logic with exponential backoff for network reliability
  • 🔧 Expanded free tier: 10 plugins, 3 profiles (up from 5 plugins, 1 list)
  • 🛡️ 41 code quality and security improvements
  • 🐛 Fixed sync timestamp accuracy
  • 🐛 Fixed plugin date parsing
  • 🐛 Fixed theme deletion compatibility
  • ✅ 32 unit tests (all passing)
  • ✅ Chrome and Firefox compatible
  • ✅ Backward compatible with v1.0.0 data

1.0.3

  • Bug fixes and UX polish
  • Improved error handling
  • Better license activation flow

1.0.2

  • Stability improvements
  • Sync enhancements
  • Data validation

1.0.1

  • Foundation release with core features
  • Theme management

  • Nonce caching
